look_here_first: Inspect opposite clasping leaves, four-angled stem and small axillary flower clusters. Check the floral tube, calyx appendages and capsule against A. auriculata; color alone is insufficient.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Texas native at state/subspecies level, three target counties not independently verified.

morphology_keys.habit: Erect annual wetland herb, often reddish four-angled stems.
morphology_keys.leaves: Opposite, sessile, narrow, clasping or auriculate bases.
morphology_keys.flowers: Small axillary flowers with persistent floral tube and calyx appendages.
morphology_keys.fruit: Many-seeded capsule surrounded by persistent floral tube.

comparisons.key_distinctions: A. auriculata often has longer slender cyme peduncles and smaller flowers. Rotala leaf bases taper; check calyx and fruit to confirm Ammannia.

diagnostic_image_needs: Floral tube and developing fruit photo candidate
